abilities.name: Lord of the Pyroclasts
abilities.originalText: While an enemy unit is engaged with this unit, that enemy unit has -1 OC.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: Unto the Anvil
abilities.trigger: ¿Está activa la doctrina de asalto para esta unidad?
abilities.originalText:
This unit’s melee attacks can:
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls.

abilities.name: Seeker of the Unfound
abilities.trigger: ¿Este modelo está dentro del rango del objetivo seleccionado?
abilities.originalText:
The first time this model is set up on the battlefield, select one objective on the battlefield. While this model is within range of that objective, this model has:
  • 10 OC.
  • 5+ Ld.
  • Feel No Pain 4+.

abilities.name: Forgefather
abilities.originalText: In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 24" of this model. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units’ [Melta]/[Torrent] attacks that target that enemy unit have +2 S.

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 6+
abilities.originalText: This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.
